name: doc-ingestion-workspace
description: Workspace runner: starts fastembed-server, ingestion-server and the Angular UI in the correct order.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:python && npm run setup:node
scripts.setup:node: npm install && npm --prefix ingestion-server install && npm --prefix doc-ingestion-ui install
scripts.start:ingestion: wait-on -t 600000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8001/health && npm --prefix ingestion-server run dev
